description: Reproduces pre-profile integrity scoring exactly. Every value here matches today's hardcoded constant bit-for-bit; changing a value is an explicit, reviewable decision, not a silent behaviour change.

layer_weight_rationale.file_integrity: Hash binding and parser success are the hardest evidence to fabricate convincingly; baseline weight.
layer_weight_rationale.declaration_consistency: Requires matching declared fields to a file the submitter does not control; baseline weight.
layer_weight_rationale.content_reconstruction: The strongest available 'did this transformation actually happen' signal when populated, since it requires a fully-parameterised declared derivation rather than a flat claim. A higher weight than the baseline is a defensible future choice on forge-cost grounds (a convincing fabricated derivation is harder to produce than a convincing flat claim), but is not applied by default: raising it is a deliberate, reviewed decision, not something this profile does silently.
layer_weight_rationale.cross_evidence_support: Independent-source corroboration (DDEX/CompSheet/CueSheet/C2PA-ingredient); currently rare in real submissions; baseline weight.
